items.statement: The final answer must reconcile the supported redox and photophysical findings within DMSO and delimit the claims about the two donors and their aryl-chloride interaction. Kinetic, bond-cleavage or yield conclusions require evidence outside the bounded endpoints and cannot be asserted from orbital or driving-force numbers alone.
